entries.name: Ruby's Play Cafe
notes: Primary play-café experience verified from the official venue website; food is an additional facility.

Official booking options list 6–12-month entry; under-6-month entry requires a full-paying sibling. Confirm current admission/session conditions: https://www.therubyplaycafe.co.uk/products/book-a-session
The venue says its café/play areas are upstairs and pushchairs must stay in the downstairs buggy park.
